## What's new in Dropshake v1.2.0

- Check for new releases from the menu bar.
- Install future releases in the app with Sparkle-powered updates.
- The first updater-enabled version must be installed manually. Future versions can update in-app.

## Install

Download `Dropshake.dmg`, open it, and drag Dropshake into Applications. Requires macOS 13 or later. The universal app supports both Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
